285:def check_entry(entry, cfg, protected, now):
286:    path = rel_path(entry["path"])
287:    if not any(within(path, x) and path != x for x in cfg["allowed_roots"]):
288:        raise Refusal("Outside explicit cleanup whitelist")
289:    if any(within(path, x) for x in protected):
290:        raise Refusal("Protected current/source path")
291:    if entry.get("category") not in ("retired_artifact", "expired_temp"):
292:        raise Refusal("Retired artifact or expired temporary file required")
293:    if not isinstance(entry.get("reason"), str) or not entry["reason"].strip():
294:        raise Refusal("Retirement reason required")
295:    quiet = entry.get("quiet_seconds", cfg["quiet_seconds"])
296:    if not isinstance(quiet, int) or quiet < cfg["quiet_seconds"]:
297:        raise Refusal("Entry cannot shorten configured quiet period")
298:    if now < parse_time(entry["retire_after"]):
299:        raise Refusal("Retirement date has not arrived")
300:    fp = entry.get("fingerprint", {})
301:    if set(fp) != {"device", "inode", "size", "mtime_ns"} or not all(
302:            isinstance(v, int) and v >= 0 for v in fp.values()):
303:        raise Refusal("Exact file stat fingerprint required")
304:    if now - fp["mtime_ns"] / 1e9 < quiet:
305:        raise Refusal("File is inside quiet period")
306:    return path

310:def parent_fd(root, relative):
311:    # dir_fd + O_NOFOLLOW stops parent symlink swaps and range escape.
312:    fd = os.open(root, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
313:    try:
314:        parts = rel_path(relative).split("/")
315:        for part in parts[:-1]:
316:            nxt = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
317:            os.close(fd)
318:            fd = nxt
319:        yield fd, parts[-1]
320:    finally:
321:        os.close(fd)

324:def file_operation(root, path, expected, apply):
325:    with parent_fd(root, path) as (parent, leaf):
326:        fd = os.open(leaf, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=parent)
327:        try:
328:            info = os.fstat(fd)
329:            if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1:
330:                raise Refusal("Only single-link regular files can be retired")
331:            if fingerprint(info) != expected:
332:                raise Refusal("File changed since manifest approval")
333:            # Recheck the leaf binding after opening it; never follow a link.
334:            current = os.stat(leaf, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
335:            if fingerprint(current) != expected or not stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode):
336:                raise Refusal("File binding changed")
337:            if apply:
338:                os.unlink(leaf, dir_fd=parent)
339:            return info.st_size
340:        finally:
341:            os.close(fd)
